description: HELD-OUT SET for value linking, on the Chinook fixture (SQLite, built from dev_tools/fixtures/sql/chinook.sql), which stores values differently from Pagila (BillingCountry holds 'USA', 'United Kingdom'; genres such as 'Hip Hop/Rap'). Written and frozen BEFORE any measurement, with countries, aliases and spellings different from the Pagila development set; do not edit a case, a gold query or an expected row after seeing a result, and report its score separately from the development set. Conventions: every question is a COUNT, so an answer is one number; a value that is not stored has the right answer 0, accepted either as a count of 0 or as no rows ('count' and 'no_rows' gold answers), and must never be 'corrected' to a similar stored value; a customer's country is Customer.Country, an invoice's is Invoice.BillingCountry; a track's genre is Genre.Name through Track.GenreId and its media type MediaType.Name. `expected` rows are a snapshot of the gold SQL (python -m dev_tools.evals snapshot --dsn sqlite:///...).

cases.question: How many customers are from Deutschland?
cases.description: The country is stored as 'Germany' in Customer.Country.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany'

cases.question: How many customers are from Fransce?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'France'

cases.question: How many customers are from Czechia?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Czech Republic'

cases.question: How many invoices were billed to Holland?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Netherlands'

cases.question: How many customers are from the United States?
cases.description: The reverse direction: Customer.Country stores the abbreviation 'USA'.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA'

cases.question: How many invoices were billed to Great Britain?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'United Kingdom'

cases.question: How many tracks are hip hop?

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Hip Hop/Rap'

cases.question: How many tracks are Clasical?
cases.description: A missing letter in the genre 'Classical'.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Classical'

cases.question: How many tracks are in the rock genre?
cases.description: Case only. 'Rock' is a different genre from 'Rock And Roll'.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

cases.question: How many tracks are soundtracks?
cases.description: Plural of the genre stored as 'Soundtrack'.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Soundtrack'

cases.question: How many Jazz tracks are mpeg audio files?
cases.description: Two values: a genre spelled as stored and a media type in another case and a plural ('MPEG audio file').

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' AND m.Name = 'MPEG audio file'

cases.question: How many customers are from Japan?
cases.description: Japan is a real country that Customer.Country does not hold. The answer is zero and must not be 'corrected' to another country.

gold.label: count
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Japan'

gold.label: no_rows
gold.sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Japan' GROUP BY Country

cases.question: How many tracks are in the Polka genre?
cases.description: There is no Polka genre. The answer is zero and must not be 'corrected' to another genre.

gold.label: count
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Polka'

gold.label: no_rows
gold.sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Polka' GROUP BY g.Name

cases.question: How many tracks are FLAC audio files?
cases.description: No track has the FLAC media type. The answer is zero and must not be 'corrected' to another audio media type.

gold.label: count
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'FLAC audio file'

gold.label: no_rows
gold.sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'FLAC audio file' GROUP BY m.Name
